extensions.description: Minimal distribution demo: displays the active session identifier and follows language and appearance. Not an assets gallery.
Browse current-session tool-result images and attachments in a thumbnail grid with image/text lightbox. Requires extension API 2 and explicit read consent; no filesystem or network access.

Browse the project repository's open issues and pull requests on GitHub, GitLab or Gitea/Forgejo with totals, search, #number lookup and labels, and open them in the browser. Requires extension API 3 and explicit read consent; reads use your signed-in gh, glab or tea, or anonymous access to public repositories; no filesystem, token or command access.

Light table for the images CodeNomad's Design agent creates in a project's Images conversation: read-back images grouped by reply, generation states, origin, small-size and side-by-side comparison, and requests added to the message box for you to send. Requires extension API 4; while enabled, CodeNomad provides its Design agent and image skills to OpenCode. The panel never sends a message, generates an image or writes a file; prompts are read only with their separate permission; no filesystem, network or command access.
